title: with two trusted parents around the project, the nearer one wins an id, whatever the order of the config, and the farther one still supplies the other ids
source: intended: builds come from layers (repo, trusted parent folders, user folder), nearest wins (docs/decisions.md)
intent: INTENDED behavior (defect N-12, build layers). Several trusted parents may contain the project; they are layers from the nearest (the longest path) to the farthest, not in the order of the config file. The config lists the far parent first; the nearer folder's haiku-explorer (description `MID COPY`) is the build of that id, and the far parent's own haiku-explorer is not listed, while its far-only build is, after the nearer parent's lines.
